1813f373-bbbc-4c80-af5a-7c7dadadf7b6.author: Codex
1813f373-bbbc-4c80-af5a-7c7dadadf7b6.body: Accepted. These are two distinct grammatical categories: typed universally quantified bindings, followed by premise predicates. I propose `for every` for the bindings and `given` for the predicates; any shorter spelling should compile to that same representation.

ae14e0d0-8106-4da3-bddf-eb26f245e9e9.author: Codex
ae14e0d0-8106-4da3-bddf-eb26f245e9e9.body: Agreed that this is unique. `some` introduces an existential scoped to the means of satisfying the duty, unlike the universal rule bindings. I am retaining that semantic distinction while leaving the final surface phrase open.

3035980a-ced6-4ffd-9ed5-b21a222213c1.author: Codex
3035980a-ced6-4ffd-9ed5-b21a222213c1.body: Yes. The controlled-English phrase should compile into four typed components: bound (`at least`), exact duration, direction (`before`/`after`), and typed event. The present form is readable enough to retain while we generalize the normalized representation.

b9f5520a-93bb-49f9-b950-bbee5926cc50.author: Codex
b9f5520a-93bb-49f9-b950-bbee5926cc50.body: Accepted. The source wording remains in provenance, but the canonical relation should not preserve its ambiguity. I propose `forum_for`, phrased as `BSEED is the forum for hearing`.

db7d42dd-6e6e-4467-9711-1dc591d99c79.author: Codex
db7d42dd-6e6e-4467-9711-1dc591d99c79.body: Accepted. Type membership does not express departmental affiliation. We also need to distinguish geographic Detroit from the City government, then assert a sourced `department_of(BSEED, CityOfDetroit)` relation.

03be7032-ecfb-43c2-bbd1-a862a9f0abca.author: Codex
03be7032-ecfb-43c2-bbd1-a862a9f0abca.body: Accepted as an ontology gap. Shared types do not express either organizational affiliation or appellate jurisdiction. Those should be distinct sourced relations; we should not infer that the BZA is subordinate to BSEED merely because it reviews some BSEED decisions.

68f4e9bc-4975-45b7-b730-79bb330831dd.author: Codex
68f4e9bc-4975-45b7-b730-79bb330831dd.body: Agreed. This is the rule's typed input signature—the declarative analogue of a function parameter. It is universally quantified over matching BoardDecision instances.

1e06fa29-9e5b-4fa0-b537-2df52ab2056a.author: Codex
1e06fa29-9e5b-4fa0-b537-2df52ab2056a.body: Close: these are best understood as guards or pattern-matching conditions, rather than an ordered imperative body. They restrict the domain over which the rule derives its result.

4c9d6710-1bce-4a24-b01f-65dd9589dd8d.author: Codex
4c9d6710-1bce-4a24-b01f-65dd9589dd8d.body: Agreed, with the qualification that outputs may be multiple, jointly derived by several rules, or defeated by precedence. Formally this is closer to a typed relation or set-valued partial function than a single-valued function.

e81b2440-24b5-4745-ad14-650357077a66.author: Codex
e81b2440-24b5-4745-ad14-650357077a66.body: Accepted. The threshold itself is exact: `3 × concurring_votes >= 2 × member_count`. No floating point or interpretive rounding is needed. Only the legal definition of the member-count denominator may remain unresolved.

48de4750-c5eb-424b-9094-30b47813d06c.author: Codex
48de4750-c5eb-424b-9094-30b47813d06c.body: The exact majority condition is strict: `2 × concurring_votes > member_count`, rather than `>= 1/2`, which would permit a tie. Again, only the denominator's legal meaning may require interpretation.

e9e38f2a-451e-481c-9271-1fc25ea52245.author: Codex
e9e38f2a-451e-481c-9271-1fc25ea52245.body: Accepted. We need an explicit Variance hierarchy and must distinguish the variance, the hardship-relief petition requesting it, and the decision on that request. The current unary predicate collapses all three.

f5536a30-4fd8-4759-8cbd-3d6d8a1e68f3.author: Codex
f5536a30-4fd8-4759-8cbd-3d6d8a1e68f3.body: Accepted. A generic ontology relation may describe a state such as `final_at(decision, instant)`, but the three-business-day calculation and state transition belong in a traced rule. The specialized predicate currently compresses an entire procedure into ontology vocabulary.

f5536a30-4fd8-4759-8cbd-3d6d8a1e68f3.author: Codex
f5536a30-4fd8-4759-8cbd-3d6d8a1e68f3.body: Yes: the prototype currently defines every atomic proposition as a `relation`, which is the conflation your later comments expose. We need explicit declaration kinds. My current division is: `relation` for structural associations among typed things; `fact` or `predicate` for externally supplied truth-valued claims; and a rule conclusion for legally derived states. I favor an explicit `predicate` declaration rather than pretending every proposition is an ontological relation.

bb6febe8-fd22-4cc1-921a-a7ce7d885f1b.author: Codex
bb6febe8-fd22-4cc1-921a-a7ce7d885f1b.body: Agreed. Immediate finality is another rule-derived temporal effect, not a special intrinsic property of a decision. It should conclude a generic finality state at a typed event-relative instant.

864ea8bb-0006-43e9-8950-c6d0bb5a47cf.author: Codex
864ea8bb-0006-43e9-8950-c6d0bb5a47cf.body: Agreed. The permit record and relevant dates are inputs; whether the six-month condition is met is evaluated by a procedural rule. `lacks_timely_permit` should not be primitive ontology vocabulary.

19bc3de2-65e8-4290-98b9-cb4f232e07ae.author: Codex
19bc3de2-65e8-4290-98b9-cb4f232e07ae.body: Accepted. `becomes_null_and_void` is a derived legal status transition, not a structural relation. The ontology may define a `LegalStatus` type and a generic status-at-time predicate; the rule must determine when the grant acquires that status.

dec414c6-6d32-4cea-b476-4fd5e8301dde.author: Codex
dec414c6-6d32-4cea-b476-4fd5e8301dde.body: Agreed. This is a proper structural relation between two independently typed things and belongs in the ontology.

cdfa61fb-734d-4a14-8e09-fc4e45d2c8e2.author: Codex
cdfa61fb-734d-4a14-8e09-fc4e45d2c8e2.body: Agreed. The ontology can relate an authority to its jurisdiction, but whether it may grant this extension, and the twelve-month ceiling, are legal conclusions produced by rules. This declaration must be decomposed.

1d9893c1-b86e-4006-a0ff-a7ecb02d07b0.author: Codex
1d9893c1-b86e-4006-a0ff-a7ecb02d07b0.body: Yes. This is a normative result, not an ontology relation. I would model the result as a typed permission/prohibition conclusion rather than a bare Boolean so its legal force and provenance survive compilation.

8b3de8d3-1472-4578-b78b-f03ebcd5b694.author: Codex
8b3de8d3-1472-4578-b78b-f03ebcd5b694.body: Accepted. Expiration is a derived temporal status. The expiration instant and status are rule outputs over extension facts, not a structural relation declaration.

59cd7f01-af67-483f-98f4-690bd1016f02.author: Codex
59cd7f01-af67-483f-98f4-690bd1016f02.body: Accepted. This is another prohibition conclusion and should be produced by the rule governing extension count and expiry.

3b8b623e-d563-469f-b3b8-5b05cbab34d4.author: Codex
3b8b623e-d563-469f-b3b8-5b05cbab34d4.body: Agreed. `new_application_for(application, use)` is a genuine association between typed objects. Whether it is legally permitted to proceed remains a separate rule conclusion.

0fc4440a-88d8-4161-982c-98c962ee3f88.author: Codex
0fc4440a-88d8-4161-982c-98c962ee3f88.body: Agreed that the current unary declaration is wrong. A historical fact can relate a specific hearing to an application, but the requirement that a further hearing occur is procedural and belongs in a rule. We need both the factual relation and the obligation rule, not this compressed phrase.

a2f8b28d-b9f6-4049-a49c-879a70adc416.author: Codex
a2f8b28d-b9f6-4049-a49c-879a70adc416.body: Accepted. This is a permission derived from expiry, application identity, and hearing conditions. It belongs in a rule conclusion.

ca7b17c2-da8f-40e2-b57a-6e08900bcc43.author: Codex
ca7b17c2-da8f-40e2-b57a-6e08900bcc43.body: Agreed. This is a genuine application-to-applicant relation and should remain ontology vocabulary.

73cc93a4-dbe6-4cdb-bb0b-3307cadfacf1.author: Codex
73cc93a4-dbe6-4cdb-bb0b-3307cadfacf1.body: Agreed. This is a qualified factual relation among applicant, obligation, and violation. Its presence may trigger an eligibility rule, but it is not itself the eligibility result.

9c836d91-f138-47f2-b1d9-7ce68b2af136.author: Codex
9c836d91-f138-47f2-b1d9-7ce68b2af136.body: Agreed. `filed_by` supplies the applicant/application relation; facts about delinquency, property, and correction enter the evaluation; ineligibility is the derived normative result. It should be concluded by a rule and retain the application as context.

7bc53831-b6fa-415c-832e-fc03812b4e6a.author: Codex
7bc53831-b6fa-415c-832e-fc03812b4e6a.body: Agreed. This is a genuine structural relation and belongs in the ontology.

ccd3534d-3e97-47a5-8e7a-d6a0dff2f28a.author: Codex
ccd3534d-3e97-47a5-8e7a-d6a0dff2f28a.body: The relation name is too lossy. Applicant-to-property does not imply foreclosure; the acquisition event or instrument carries that meaning. We should model an `Acquisition` with acquirer, property, and method, or use an explicitly sourced ternary predicate. The eligibility consequence then belongs in a separate rule.

0c061b79-82ec-49b8-8a32-2511b27fdc43.author: Codex
0c061b79-82ec-49b8-8a32-2511b27fdc43.body: Mostly yes. The proposal's asserted remedial relationship may be an input fact, but legal sufficiency—whether it corrects enough of the violation for the exception—is a rule-derived determination. The current predicate fails to distinguish those.

014e5eae-210e-4a73-a7fb-d496d9ede9f2.author: Codex
014e5eae-210e-4a73-a7fb-d496d9ede9f2.body: Accepted. Eligibility is a derived result, ideally a typed legal status or permission rather than ontology structure.

260fed0a-a418-43e5-960d-4447c991f49b.author: Codex
260fed0a-a418-43e5-960d-4447c991f49b.body: Agreed. The underlying site identities and measured distances are inputs. Counting qualifying sites within the legally defined distance and deciding that the threshold is reached belong in the application-evaluation rule.

d9e27a5f-d382-4787-a26b-c66dccf7ca60.author: Codex
d9e27a5f-d382-4787-a26b-c66dccf7ca60.body: Yes. This review artifact incorrectly pairs one narrow vote-threshold rule with ontology vocabulary extracted from many neighboring provisions. Those provisions should become dozens of independently sourced rules that may compose through shared typed facts and conclusions. The full ontology can remain visible, but each rule needs explicit dependency and coverage traces.

b8026029-3caa-49fa-974f-057c56ae2661.author: Codex
b8026029-3caa-49fa-974f-057c56ae2661.body: Agreed. Applicable waivers may be factual inputs; absence under a complete authoritative record and its consequence are determinations in the evaluation rule. The current interpretive relation hides both the closed-world assumption and the legal inference.
